subject: PO sequencing and spend-cap reconciliation for GreenGrid vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@greengrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenGrid Finance <finance@greengrid.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding / initial PO ask

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough Friday. Were ready to kick off the onboarding for GreenGrids integration with Redwood. To get our first invoice processed on Jan 6 we need a PO number issued and visibility on the initial spend cap so our finance team can calendar payment.

Quick details:
- Proposed initial purchase: Professional services + 12 months of dedicated seats (line items attached in the pricing sheet).
- Requested provisional spend cap: $250,000 (we may invoice in two installments).
- Line-item detail: the services line needs to be split into two SKUs for our ledger (GG-SVC-CORE / GG-SVC-EXT).

Attached: GreenGrid_Onboarding_Form.pdf (completed), GG_pricing_v1.xlsx (line-item breakdown).

Can you confirm what PO sequence number well get and whether Redwood can split the PO so our accounting maps each SKU separately? Also let us know any additional supplier docs you need (W-9, bank details, etc).

Thanks,
Lisa Park
Vendor Operations Lead
GreenGrid Energy
phone: (415) 555-0192


From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@greengrid.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / initial PO ask

Lisa 

Thanks for the form and line-item sheet — helpful. Welcome aboard.

High-level next steps from our side:
- Procurement will provision a provisional PO number (youll get a PDF stub). We can itemize SKUs on the PO so your AP team can map them; please confirm exact SKU codes in the spreadsheet (I highlighted the service split rows).
- We typically set a provisional spend ceiling and then move to the committed spend once contracts are fully executed. Procurement prefers to start with $200,000 until legal completes the SOW sign-off. If GreenGrid needs a higher provisional cap we can escalate.
- Please provide a signed W-9 (or equivalent vendor tax doc) and bank remit instructions to speed supplier setup.

Marcus / Mina — can you: (1) confirm the PO sequencing (next available PO number), (2) advise whether we can approve $250k provisional against a shorter payment SLA or if the system requires $200k, and (3) confirm how PO attachments will appear in the ledger so GreenGrid can map SKUs?

Lisa  Ill mark this as high-priority and follow up if procurement needs anything else.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Phone: 650-555-0211

Attachments: PO_DRAFT_GG_001.pdf (provisional PO stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@greengrid.com>, GreenGrid Finance <finance@greengrid.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / initial PO ask

Marissa / team —

On the PO sequencing: next available sequence is PO-2027-0142. We can issue PO-2027-0142 as a provisional PO now and update it post-SOW. Notes below: 

1) Spend cap enforcement: our AP system enforces spend caps at the PO header level. We can set header cap = $225,000 as an interim—this gives you buffer above $200k but still below the $250k ask. If GreenGrid requires $250k now, well need written approval from Finance with an SLA justification (turnaround on invoices).

2) Line-item split: we can show two separate line items on the PO and provide a CSV export for your AP mapping. Proposed mapping from the spreadsheet:
- SKU-GG-CORE: services (qty 1) — $150,000
- SKU-GG-EXTRA: add-ons (qty 1) — $75,000
- Hosting: RDW-HOST-ANNUAL (qty 1) — $25,000

3) Supplier docs: we need a completed W-9 (or W-8 for non-US) and a supplier setup form. Lisa: please upload the signed W-9 to the DocuSign envelope link and drop bank remit to the secure drive link above.

4) Timeline: if we get W-9 + remit + signed SOW by Wednesday (Dec 23), procurement will issue the final PO (with final cap) on Dec 24. If one element is missing we can still issue the provisional PO-2027-0142 but it will have the $225k header cap until completed.

Related: HubSpot ticket HSP-98321 attached for tracking.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@greengrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenGrid Finance <finance@greengrid.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / initial PO ask

Marcus / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Ive uploaded the signed W-9 to the DocuSign envelope (https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Status/abc-gg-w9) and attached W9_GreenGrid_signed.pdf. Bank remit instructions are in the drive link you shared. GreenGrid can accept the provisional PO-2027-0142 with a $225,000 header cap for now — well sign the SOW and request the final PO increase if needed.

Confirming the SKU split as: SKU-GG-CORE ($150k), SKU-GG-EXTRA ($75k), RDW-HOST-ANNUAL ($25k). Were aiming to invoice Jan 06 for the first milestone. Please send the final PO PDF and the PO number to our AP contact at finance@greengrid.com so they can calendar payment.

Appreciate it — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Lisa Park
Vendor Operations Lead
GreenGrid Energy

Attachments: W9_GreenGrid_signed.pdf
